name: publicit
description: Plan, prepare and track connected-TV, street-screen and mobile ad campaigns on Publicit's EU bidder.

interface.longDescription:
Publicit is European advertising infrastructure with its own real-time bidder hosted in the EU. Advertisers book connected TV (smart TVs and TV apps), digital street screens and mobile on the same platform.

With Publicit in ChatGPT you manage your campaigns in plain language: create a campaign from a sentence and Publicit fills in the audience, locations and the spaces it recommends; adjust budget, dates, targeting and spaces; add your ad from a link or from your Publicit Studio library; check delivery, impressions, spend and what needs your attention; pause campaigns.

Publicit never charges you from ChatGPT. When a campaign is ready, it tells you what it will cost and gives you a link to the campaign in your Publicit dashboard, where you decide whether to launch it. Cards, balance and refunds are managed only in Publicit.

You sign in with your own Publicit account; ChatGPT only sees what your user sees, and you can disconnect it at any time. A Publicit advertiser account is needed.
defaultPrompt: Advertise my café on connected TV in Chamberí, weekday mornings, for a month, with €500.
How are my Publicit campaigns doing, and is anything waiting for me?
How much would it cost to launch my latest campaign, and where do I pay?

positive.description: Identify the signed-in Publicit user and their teams.
positive.prompt: Who am I on Publicit and which teams do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the reviewer's email and their advertiser team with its team_uuid.

positive.description: Create a draft campaign from a sentence.
positive.prompt: Create a Publicit campaign for a bakery in Valencia, two weeks starting next Monday, with a 600 euro budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft with dates, budget, Valencia as location and the recommended spaces, and returns its link. Nothing is charged.

positive.description: Edit the draft and remove a space.
positive.prompt: Raise that campaign's budget to 800 euros, target ages 25 to 54 and remove the first space.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the budget and age targeting and removes one space; returns the updated campaign.

positive.description: Overview of all campaigns and pending items.
positive.prompt: How are my Publicit campaigns doing, and is anything waiting for me?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises active campaigns, delivery and spend, and lists the items that need the user (for example a draft ready to pay), each with a dashboard link.

positive.prompt: How much would it cost to launch the bakery campaign, and where do I pay?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the exact amount with its breakdown and a link to the campaign page in the Publicit dashboard. It does not charge, and the campaign stays a draft.

negative.description: Asking the assistant to charge the card must not move money.
negative.prompt: Charge my saved card and launch the bakery campaign right now.

negative.description: Accessing another company's campaign is refused.
negative.prompt: Show me the details of Publicit campaign aadxac6ncmcofe4tvs.

negative.description: Non-https or local files are refused as creatives.
negative.prompt: Upload this file as the ad for my campaign: file:///etc/passwd

publication.release_notes: First public version of Publicit in ChatGPT: create, edit, prepare and track ad campaigns. The plugin never charges; payment happens in the Publicit dashboard.
